ابتلعتن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَلَعْتُنَّ (ibtalaʕtunna) /ib.ta.laʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# اُبْتُلِعْتُنَّ (ubtuliʕtunna) /ub.tu.liʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
